meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会明白 Codex Rules 会自动工作：在会话开始和每次提问时注入项目的静态规则；Codex 改动文件后会注入匹配该文件的规则。注入内容只作为额外上下文，不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户问起 Codex Rules 的运作方式、规则文件位置、环境配置等问题时，技能会自动说明。

say.text: Codex Rules 能读取哪些规则文件？
怎么用环境变量临时关闭 Codex Rules？
放在 .cursor/rules 下的规则会被加载吗？
say.note: 会，只要符合匹配条件就自动注入。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude knows Codex Rules works by itself: it injects static project rules at session start and on each user prompt; after Codex applies a patch, it injects file-specific rules. Extra dynamic output is just added context, never rewritten.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, rule file locations, environment configuration, or similar topics.

say_en.text: Which rule files can Codex Rules read?
say_en.note: Lists supported sources such as CONTEXT.md and .omo/rules.
